sources.title: license_plate_recognition_pipelined_image.ipynb - Colab
sources.snippet: This notebook is an example of how to use DeGirum PySDK to do AI inference of a graphical file using two AI models: license plate detection and license recognition. The license plate detection model is run on the image and the results are then processed by the license recognition model, one license plate at a time. Combined result is then displayed. This script uses PIL as image processing ...

sources.title: imtiaz-ahmed8251/ai-license-plate-reader - GitHub
sources.snippet: AI-Powered Detection: Leverages the multimodal capabilities of the Gemini 1.5 Flash model to find license plates. Bounding Box Annotation: Visually highlights the detected license plate on the original image. Text Extraction: Reads and displays the characters from the license plate. User-Friendly Interface: Clean and simple UI powered by Streamlit.
